Context: 8. Pensionary terms for Central Government Employees absorbed consequent on conversion of Departments into Autonomous Body or a PSU

10. The Government will discharge its pensionary liability in lumpsum as a one-time payment to the Pension Fund, the pension or Service Gratuity and Retirement Gratuity for the service up to the date of absorption of the Government servant. Lumpsum amount of pension will be calculated on the basis of Commutation Table in the CCS (Commutation of Pension) Rules, 1981.
